question_text: Outline how a closed-loop controller can keep an aquarium near a chosen temperature using a sensor,processor and heater.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Store the target. Read the temperature sensor. Compare actual with target. Signal the heater actuator to heat when below the lower threshold and stop above the upper threshold. Continue sampling so the resulting temperature affects later decisions.
